Resolves #9160

Replaces wall-clock `timeout(50)` waits in `test/playwright/unit/grid/Pooling.spec.mjs` with deterministic VDOM flight draining (`settleBody`: `while (body?.isVdomUpdating || body?.needsVdomUpdate) { await body.promiseUpdate() }`) and passes `silent: true` to the synchronous idempotency check (`componentGrid.body.createViewData(true)`). When `body.set({availableHeight: 360, containerWidth: 600})` runs, `afterSetAvailableHeight` executes first with `mountedColumns = [0, 0]` (starting Flight #1), while `afterSetContainerWidth` updates `mountedColumns` to `[0, 2]` and defers Flight #2 into `VDomUpdate.registerPreUpdate`. Because `executePreUpdates` runs synchronously inside Flight #1's `resolveVdomUpdate`, `executionCount` reaches `14` before Flight #2's `insertNode` batch settles; under CI load (`defect-note b1eb6a69`), `timeout(50)` could expire between Flight #1 and Flight #2 (and `createViewData()` with `silent = false` also launched an unawaited Flight #3), leaking initial column `insertNode` deltas into `captureDeltas` at `:549`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit runner in CI and local `--repeat-each=10` `90/90` pass) → L2 required (unit test determinism on `test/playwright/unit/grid/Pooling.spec.mjs`). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: micro — test-only deterministic settlement fix (`+15 / -4` lines in `test/playwright/unit/grid/Pooling.spec.mjs`).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `unit` and `PR body` run in CI.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** micro — test-only: one unit spec swaps a fixed 50 ms wait for draining the body's own VDOM flights; no engine source, no contract.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim: the #9160 budget arm (`Pooling.spec.mjs:458`) flaked because the initial `body.set({availableHeight, containerWidth})` mounts in two flights, the second deferred through `registerPreUpdate` (`src/grid/Body.mjs:846-858`), and under CI load the fixed `timeout(50)` could close before it landed, leaking its `insertNode` deltas into the capture. Verified at exact head `9c9deddcab`. `settleBody` is bounded: `resolveVdomUpdate` clears `isVdomUpdating` before the callbacks and starts any follow-up flight synchronously (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`), and a temporary probe (reverted) counted 0 or 2 iterations, 2 being the two-flight mount the PR names. Locally: 90/90 at `--repeat-each=10`. The old spec did not reproduce the flake here (360/360 at `--repeat-each=40`, 8 workers), consistent with a hosted-load race; the new wait is deterministic by construction, not by margin. Looked for and not found as a live defect: `captureDeltas` settles `grid?.body` (the `beforeEach` grid) while the budget arm drives `componentGrid`. The arm's operation awaits each `componentGrid.view` flight itself, and the probe found that body and view idle after the scroll loop in 10/10 runs, so nothing escapes the capture today. A future arm that drives a second grid without awaiting its own flights should pass its body into `captureDeltas`.

**Findings:** None.
